name: Unagi Banra
source:
Enhanced comrade, created and modified by Lolikov. Shy and timid. Her duty is a fleet commanding. Because of her big breasts Lolikov was mistreating her.

Has eel-like outer features ("unagi" is Japanese for "eel"). Sometimes electric shoking.

"I'm really sorry. I'm sorry I came into the world, I'm sorry..."
